## PMM: general cognitive factor by class

```{r}
a2_2_pmm_gcp |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Class = as.character(class),
    Mean = est_Means,
    SD = sd,
    Variance = est_Variances
  ) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(Mean, SD, Variance), decimals = 1) |>
  gt::cols_align("center", columns = -Class) |>
  a2_2_gt_style(font = 26, width = 70)
```

<div style="font-size: 0.6em; line-height: 1.3;">
Model-implied mean and variance estimates reflect adjustment for sociodemographics at the indicator level.  

`r a2_2_reflection_note`
</div>
